tool_versions./workspace/EmbCC/embcc:
EmbCC 1.0.0-m2.complete (the Emb toolchain's C and C++ compiler, for embedded systems and operating systems)
Target: x86_64-elf
Default target: x86_64-elf
Targets: Cortex-M (ARMv6-M, ARMv7-M, ARMv7E-M, ARMv8-M Baseline and Mainline), ARMv7-A, RISC-V (RV32, RV64),
AVR (ATmega), Xtensa (ESP32, windowed ABI), TriCore, Renesas RX, ColdFire (m68k, ISA_A), MIPS32 and MIPS64
(both byte orders), PowerPC (32-bit EABI), SPARC V8 (LEON3), LoongArch64 (LP64S); x86-64 and AArch64
(bare metal, EmbLinkOS, Linux, Darwin; x86-64 also Windows)
Languages: C11 with the GNU extensions; C++ toward C++20 on every target but AVR
Linker: embld, for every target's images; AArch64 and Darwin link with the platform's linker
Not yet: position-independent executables, shared libraries, dynamic linking. See docs/internals/status.md.
